subject: Support sublane claim: Gen6 safe logical-inner identity + mutation preconditions
body: STARTING_MAIN_SHA=699ed29288ab2aa24463902fcefe752d432717d2. A peer already owns the broad P0 early-wake -> first-useful-presentation lane, so this worker is NOT duplicating that end-to-end work. Narrow support sublane only: source-validate how a disabled/non-default 1968x2184 Fold7 logical inner route can be identified against the stable physical inner panel, define revalidation/fail-closed preconditions before any enableConnectedDisplay/requestDisplayPower experiment, and provide deterministic adversarial identity/remap tests plus exact integration seams to the lane owner/Manager. Existing shell source already exposes include-disabled logical enumeration and generic enable/power primitives, but the current logical->physical helper is cover-geometry-specific; that identity hole is the focus. No production Git writes; no task/default migration; virtual/predicted hinge remains visual-only.
